emulatorSetup.title: Set up your first emulator
emulatorSetup.description: Ilnamiki needs an emulator to play your games. We recommend RetroArch to get started: a single download that supports multiple consoles.

platformSetup.title: Your emulator has no consoles yet
platformSetup.description: Your emulator is ready, but it can't play any console yet. Set it up to add the consoles you want to play; in RetroArch, by installing their cores.
